story.title: Accept and learn from your mistakes
paragraphs_en: There was a girl named Aisha. One day she went to her coaching class and the teacher conducted Science test. But Aisha didn’t know any answers. She still gave the test. When result came she was sad because it was her worst performance.

She told her mother that she scored .But in reality she had scored just 3 numbers in the test. She thought her family members especially her younger brother will laugh on her. She kept on thinking about her lie and after few days she was fed up and decided to tell the truth.

She went to her mother and said I had scored just 3 numbers in my test and that she lied to all. Her mother said, its fine next time we will be prepared for these surprise tests. And her mother guided her that we should not bother about what others will think.

. The most important thing is that you tried and that’s enough. And that she should study hard and be ready for next tests and give our best efforts. That day Aisha learned truth is always better and it helps us to achieve best.
